title: Alteration keeping size and modification time (one critical file, one ordinary file)

expected.notes: The ordinary raw file has no copy anywhere, so its alteration can be detected but not repaired. It is outside Delivery 2, the requested target: it is reported apart and never added to the plan. A metadata-only review of ordinary files misses it; this is the trade-off policy POL-0001 v2 addresses.
